name: Monsoon squall + Sahar access-road blockage

steps.label: Weather
steps.description: Scripted squall: rainfall set to 50 mm/h.

steps.label: Traffic
steps.description: Configured Sahar inbound segment set to 5 km/h, BLOCKED.

steps.label: Demand
steps.description: Synthetic T2 arrivals in the next 30 min: 4 widebody flights, ~1,200 assumed passengers.

steps.label: Impact
steps.description: Demand-pressure model re-run with the simulated road and weather capacity factors.

steps.label: Recommendation
steps.description: Thresholds evaluated; structured recommendation raised for operator review.

assumptions: Rainfall (50 mm/h) and road speed (5 km/h) are scripted inputs, not a forecast or observed closure.
Passenger counts are synthetic: seats × assumed load factor for demo flights.
Vehicle split, passengers per vehicle, forecourt capacity and capacity factors are illustrative configuration.
No actual road closure, queue time or capacity breach is asserted.
